title: Update experience: download only the changed files, preview, splash, relaunch (next Flow release)
description:
UMBRELLA: MPI-559 - App install, first run and updates. Members and phase order: tasks/MPI-559/plan.md. Joined 2026-10-18 (Fabio, board tidy).

Updater compares the latest full zip's file list with the install and fetches only the changed files (whole zip as fallback); the prompt previews the notes; a splash replaces the console; the app relaunches on every path. Ships with the next Flow release, not alone. Brief: brief.md.
